subject: Silverpine AWS private offer — payments path & evaluation sprint
messages:
From: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.ai>
To: Anna Lopez <anna.lopez@silverpine.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 01 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Silverpine AWS private offer — initial MAP & billing questions

Hi Anna —

Thanks again for the demo last week. Per our conversation I put together a short mutual action plan (MAP) that sequences the eval sprint, procurement milestones, and the AWS private offer billing path so procurement and engineering have a single reference. I attached the MAP workbook and a quick SOC2 summary we typically hand to procurement teams.

High-level ask: can you confirm the following on your side so we can finalise milestones?
- Procurement approver name and target PO date (we asked for PO or signed order form to trigger marketplace private offer).
- Any internal billing flow specifics (AP contact, order type: PO vs corporate card).
- Legal redline owner and target review date.

Proposed timeline (draft):
1) 6/2–6/9: Technical eval sprint (POC access via hosted sandbox; Redwood provides sample dataset config)
2) 6/10–6/16: Procurement & legal review (Redwood provides order form + AWS private offer instructions)
3) 6/18: Target PO received / private offer activated in AWS marketplace

I looped Ben (billing) to describe the exact invoicing sequence for marketplace private offers — he’ll outline whether we push invoice via AWS billing or arrange direct invoicing for the initial commit.

Attachments: silverpine-map-20270601.xlsx, soc2-readme-20270601.pdf

If that looks reasonable, can you reply with procurement owner and a preferred time for a 30-min sync (tomorrow/Thursday) to run through the MAP?

Thanks —

Chloe Martin
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
chloe.martin@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0192

From: Anna Lopez <anna.lopez@silverpine.com>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.ai>
Cc: James Carter <james.carter@silverpine.com>, procurement@silverpine.com
Date: Wed, 02 Jun 2027 10:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Silverpine AWS private offer — initial MAP & billing questions

Chloe —

Thanks for the MAP. Quick answers from procurement:
- Procurement contact: Anna Lopez (me) — final PO approver is our Finance Director (M. Reyes). Target internal signoff by 6/17.
- Billing: preference is AWS marketplace private offer so charges roll through our consolidated AWS invoice. We do need a formal PO and order form to attach to our system.
- Legal: legal@silverpine.com will take redlines; please send the order form and any standard SOW language.

On the eval sprint: our infra lead James will join the technical sync and needs an IAM plan for the private offer sandbox. Do you have short instructions for temporary role permissions?

Can we do a call tomorrow 6/3 at 11am PT to triage the MAP items?

Anna Lopez
Procurement Lead, Silverpine Systems
anna.lopez@silverpine.com

From: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.ai>
To: Anna Lopez <anna.lopez@silverpine.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 03 Jun 2027 08:43:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Silverpine AWS private offer — MAP + eval sprint details

Anna —

Thanks — confirmed for 6/3 11am PT. Attached is a one-page MAP export (same workbook) with sprint tasks, acceptance criteria for the POC, and the order form template (rdw-orderform-silverpine-v1.docx). Key items we’ll cover tomorrow:

- IAM & sandbox access: we’ll provision a time-limited cross-account role in your AWS account scoped to the inference VPC and S3 read-only for the eval dataset; James, you’ll get an ARN and a short deploy script.
- POC acceptance criteria (pass/fail): 1) generate 99% of expected throughput for 512-token prompts; 2) latency under 250ms p50 for light queries; 3) inference logs delivered to your CloudWatch bucket.
- Billing: when private offer is accepted in AWS, charges appear on Silverpine’s AWS invoice. For accounting we recommend Silverpine issue a PO referencing the AWS private offer ID so your AP team can match it at month end. If you need direct invoice we can provision that for the first billing cycle as an exception (note: requires an internal finance approval).

Attachments listed in this mail: silverpine-map-20270601.xlsx, rdw-orderform-silverpine-v1.docx, soc2-readme-20270601.pdf

See you tomorrow —

Chloe

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Anna Lopez <anna.lopez@silverpine.com>, Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 04 Jun 2027 11:27:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Silverpine AWS private offer — billing flow and HubSpot link

Anna / Chloe —

Following our sync, a few billing notes to make procurement’s life easier:

1) AWS private offer path: after you accept the private offer in the AWS Marketplace console, usage will appear on your consolidated AWS bill. Please attach your PO and the private offer acceptance to the invoice as supporting documentation.
2) For automated reconciliation we’ll add the private offer SKU and the Redwood deal ID to the order form (RDW-2027-SP-0043). That helps your AP match invoice lines.
3) If you need a Redwood-origin invoice (instead of AWS) for the first month, we can provide a one-off partner invoice; we’ll need the Silverpine AP contact and remit-to details.

HubSpot: https://hubspot.example.com/deal/RDW-2027-SP-0043 (I updated the MAP milestones and committed the private offer SKU in the deal record).

Best —
Ben Carter
Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai

From: Anna Lopez <anna.lopez@silverpine.com>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: James Carter <james.carter@silverpine.com>, procurement@silverpine.com
Date: Wed, 09 Jun 2027 14:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Silverpine AWS private offer — legal redlines & procurement timeline

Chloe / Ben —

Legal has requested minor redlines to the order form (payment terms 30 net -> 45 net for our standard policy; standard indemnity language adjusted). They asked for a 72-hour turnaround on revised language. Our target: procurement approval by 6/17 provided redlines are handled on time.

We’ll plan to issue a PO referencing the private offer ID once legal signs off and Finance signs the PO on 6/17. Can Redwood confirm you can accept the 45 net payment term for this deal if we proceed via AWS private offer?

Thanks —
Anna

From: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.ai>
To: Anna Lopez <anna.lopez@silverpine.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 11 Jun 2027 16:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Silverpine AWS private offer — final MAP & next steps (PO target 6/18)

Anna —

Appreciate the quick turnaround. Confirm Redwood can accept 45 net for this purchase when processed through the AWS private offer flow. Summary & next steps:

- Legal: Redwood to provide revised order form reflecting 45 net and the small indemnity tweak; Laura (cc’d) will send updated doc by EOD 6/12.
- Procurement: Silverpine targets internal signoff 6/17; please issue PO referencing private offer ID and RDW-2027-SP-0043. We’ll use that PO to reconcile AWS invoice lines.
- Technical: James to receive cross-account role ARN and short deploy script by 6/4 (we sent the sample IAM instructions in the MAP).
- Activation: target private offer acceptance and first-day provisioning on 6/18.

Attachments: silverpine-map-20270601.xlsx, rdw-orderform-silverpine-v1.docx (updated will follow).

DocuSign link for signature-ready order form (for legal convenience): https://docusign.example.com/template/rdw-aws-private-offer

If we stay on this schedule I’ll mark the HubSpot deal RDW-2027-SP-0043 as "private-offer-scheduled" and loop in Customer Success for the onboarding runbook.

Thanks all — looking forward to the POC.

Chloe Martin
